verdict.rationale: Weaviate is a vector database platform that could plausibly offer user-configured background automations such as scheduled jobs or autonomous agents, so the axis applies. The pack does not evidence any such capability. The Query Agent (weaviate-docs-27) is interactive agentic search, and weaviate-docs-4 describes external agents that use Weaviate data, not automations that Weaviate runs autonomously. Built-in automatic behaviors like vectorization at import or auto-tenant creation are not user-defined background automations.
